( 08 )  Before your visit

Good questions.

What is payable in advance?

The owner asks for one month's rent in advance (₹7,500). There is no fixed security deposit. Confirm the payment date and all terms directly with the owner.

Is the flat ready to move into?

The flat was photographed during paintwork. Contact the owner to confirm the completion date and move-in availability.

What do the photos and the walkthrough show?

The walkthrough presents real photographs in 3D space. It is not a 360° scan or a measured floor plan. Cleaned previews are AI-retouched; use "Original photos" in the gallery, or the before/after slider, to see the photos taken during paintwork.

How many rooms are there, and what is included?

Please confirm the room count, floor area, furnishing, water and electricity arrangements, and any additional charges directly with the owner. Several photographs show the same spaces from different angles.
